verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled pipelines that run unattended, orchestrated through Apache Airflow. It also tracks incremental state so recurring runs pick up where the last one left off, and it advertises built-in monitoring and alerts plus a managed hosting option. Background scheduling depends on an external orchestrator, and the evidence shows no AI-driven or agentic automation. missing for 10: native scheduling without Airflow, any AI/agent-triggered autonomous automation, detailed docs on schedule setup and background execution, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended scheduled runs.
